verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere does host public GitHub repos (e.g., runanywhere-sdks, wally) suggesting open source, but a hands-on community report explicitly states the CLI wrapper (RCLI) is MIT-licensed while the core inference engine (MetalRT) is proprietary/commercial, calling the repo 'misleading' — so the actual model-execution core is not openly licensed despite surface-level open repos. missing for 10: full source-available license for the core engine, first-party confirmation of licensing scope, independent audit resolving the discrepancy.
